newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates unchanged, seen steady.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates unchanged, seen steady.

text.p: The Pakistani cotton rates ended unchanged on Saturday in dull trading as demand from mill owners remained depressed owing to a shortage of funds and will hover around these levels in the near term, dealers said.
"The trading continues to remain dull as mill owners are short of funds," dealer Khushi Ram said. "Most deals are being made on credit as ginneries have piles of unsold stocks."

The Cotton Export Corporation of Pakistan said there were 1.17 million 375-lb bales of unsold stocks in Punjab and Sindh provinces. In the kerb, the NIAB-78 variety was traded around 1,900 rupees ($47.24) per maund (37.32 kg), dealers said.
